items.summary: Add an admin-only backend function to purge old/legacy data by deleting all DailyServiceReport records and deleting all user profiles except the calling admin user (to avoid locking the system), and ensure authorization roles are revoked for any deleted users.

Expose the purge operation in the frontend admin area by adding a destructive "Delete all old data" action on the Admin Users page with an explicit confirmation dialog, and wire it to a new React Query mutation that calls the backend purge function and invalidates relevant cached queries (users, reports, currentUserProfile).
